items.prompt: Shade one half of the square.
hints: The square is cut into 4 equal parts.
A half is the same as 2 out of 4.
items.explanation: One half is the same as 2 out of 4 equal parts, so shade 2 parts.

items.prompt: Shade two thirds of the circle.
hints: The circle is cut into 3 parts.
Two thirds means 2 of the 3 parts.
items.explanation: Two thirds means 2 out of 3 equal parts. Shade 2 parts of the circle.

items.prompt: True or false: A shape cut into 4 equal parts shows quarters.
items.explanation: Quarters are 4 equal parts of a whole.

items.prompt: True or false: A shape cut into 3 parts of different sizes shows thirds.
hints: What must be true about thirds?
Look at the sizes of the parts.
items.explanation: Thirds must be equal parts. Parts of different sizes are not thirds.
